name: Trinkets and Trackers
description:
Trinkets and Trackers is an interactive Roll20 Mod/API script for Dungeons & Dragons games. It helps GMs and players manage shops, character inventory, item transfers, currency, item catalog searches, healing consumables, and token-based item actions.

Commands:
!tnt or !tntHelp -- Shows the command help menu.
!tntToken init -- Creates token actions for the selected character token.
!tntShop menu -- Opens the GM shop administration menu.
!tntItem search ?{Item Name|} -- Searches the item catalog.
!tntItem list -- Shows the full item catalog to the GM.

This script is designed to make inventory, shop, item usage, and loot-related interactions faster, cleaner, and more immersive inside Roll20.
